title: Trump Signs Proclamation To Make Oval Office A National Monument
summary: On November 5, U.S. President Donald Trump signed a proclamation declaring the White House’s Oval Office and Cabinet Room as a national monument—a designation that protects the spaces from major alterations in the future. title: Milwaukee Art Museum Receives $10 Million Gift for Works on Paper
summary: Sheldon and Marianne Lubar have committed $10 million to the Milwaukee Art Museum to establish the Lubar Family Center for Drawings and Prints. summary: Five oil sketches by Peter Paul Rubens were removed from Ducal Museum in Gotha, Germany, during World War II.
